display.purpose: Wordmark H1 and the passage scent names.

product-name.purpose: Every scent tile in the one-screen grid.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one filled control per screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:.5rem; min-height:50px; padding:0 26px; border:0; border-radius:999px; background:#2F4A2A; color:#fff; font:700 16px 'Nunito Sans', sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background .15s, transform .15s } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#3E5E38 } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(1px) } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #2F4A2A; outline-offset:3px } .ds-price { padding-left:8px; margin-left:6px; border-left:1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / .35); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums }

components.name: Text Button
components.css: .ds-text-btn { background:none; border:0; padding:0; font:700 16px 'Nunito Sans', sans-serif; color:#1F3320; text-decoration:underline; text-decoration-thickness:1.5px; text-underline-offset:4px; cursor:pointer } .ds-text-btn:hover { color:#2F4A2A } .ds-text-btn:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #2F4A2A; outline-offset:3px }

components.name: Scent Tile
components.description: A scent in the one-screen grid; selection is weight + underline.
components.css: .ds-tiles { display:flex; gap:22px; background:#F6F1E7; padding:12px } .ds-tile { display:flex; gap:5px; align-items:flex-start; background:none; border:0; padding:6px 0; cursor:pointer; text-align:left } .ds-name { font:600 1.15rem/1.12 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif; color:#1F3320; text-decoration-thickness:2px; text-underline-offset:4px; text-decoration-color:#2F4A2A } .ds-tile:hover .ds-name { text-decoration-line:underline; text-decoration-color:rgb(47 74 42 / .45) } .ds-tile[aria-pressed=true] .ds-name { font-weight:700; text-decoration-line:underline } .ds-num { font:800 .72rem/1.5 'Nunito Sans', sans-serif; color:#C9A24A } .ds-tile:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #2F4A2A; outline-offset:3px; border-radius:4px }

components.name: Size Option
components.description: Variant option with tabular price beneath.
components.css: .ds-seg { display:flex; gap:22px; background:#F6F1E7; padding:12px } .ds-opt { display:inline-flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:flex-start; min-height:44px; padding:4px 0; background:none; border:0; cursor:pointer; font:400 1rem/1.2 'Nunito Sans', sans-serif } .ds-lbl { color:#1F3320; text-decoration-thickness:2px; text-underline-offset:4px; text-decoration-color:#2F4A2A } .ds-opt[aria-pressed=true] .ds-lbl { font-weight:700; text-decoration-line:underline } .ds-sub { font-size:.8rem; color:#5A6657; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums }

components.name: Input
components.description: Strokeless field on the paper form surface.
components.css: .ds-form { display:grid; gap:6px; padding:24px; background:#FDFBF6; border-radius:22px } .ds-label { font:700 .95rem 'Nunito Sans', sans-serif; color:#1F2A1D } .ds-input { min-height:50px; padding:10px 14px; border:0; border-radius:10px; background:#F6F1E7; font:400 16px 'Nunito Sans', sans-serif; caret-color:#2F4A2A } .ds-input:focus { outline:3px solid #2F4A2A; outline-offset:2px }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Sticky cream bar with no rule.
components.html: VALEO BODYShopCart 2
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; height:64px; padding:0 24px; background:rgb(246 241 231 / .88); backdrop-filter:blur(12px) } .ds-wordmark { font:700 1.5rem 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif; letter-spacing:.14em; color:#1F3320 } .ds-links { display:flex; gap:22px } .ds-links a { font:700 16px 'Nunito Sans', sans-serif; color:#1F3320; text-decoration:none } .ds-links a:hover { text-decoration:underline; text-decoration-thickness:2px; text-underline-offset:5px } .ds-count { display:inline-grid; place-items:center; min-width:24px; height:24px; padding:0 7px; border-radius:12px; background:#2F4A2A; color:#fff; font-size:.8rem }

narrative.overview: One jar, photographed once, sits on dairy cream and never moves; the scent worlds move past it. Typographic before graphic: Cormorant names things, Nunito Sans operates. Selection is weight plus a green underline; one filled control per screen; no hairlines, chips, badges, or cards; photographs float on the ground.
keyCharacteristics: Dairy cream ground, botanical green voice, gold ≤3 marks per viewport
Photography and lazy video on the ground, unframed

rules.name: The One Filled Control Rule
rules.body: Per screen, exactly one element has an opaque filled background acting as a control.

rules.name: The Three Gold Marks Rule
rules.body: Gold is visible at most three times in any viewport.

rules.name: The Serif Names Things Rule
rules.body: Scents, products, totals and the brand are Cormorant; instructions and sub-labels are Nunito Sans.

dos: Do indicate selection with weight + a 2px green underline offset 4px, identically everywhere.
Do separate with whitespace or a tonal step.
Do float photographs on the ground.
donts: Don't fill more than one control per screen.
Don't put a scent in a tinted chip, card, or behind an icon.
Don't add kickers, badges, numbered counters, or emoji-class icons.
